title: Landmarks
about: A landmark in the picture sets the earliest possible year: the photo can't be older than the building. Watch for cranes and half-built towers too, and for buildings that are gone (Twin Towers). Pre-1900 icons (Eiffel Tower 1889, Tower Bridge 1894, Statue of Liberty 1886) don't narrow anything down.
